brief:
Israeli forces conducted a surprise drill early Sunday at general staff level to test readiness for a large-scale, complex multi-front conflict, Shehab Wire reported. The exercise, carried out at dawn, involved commanders across various military commands, branches, and units in an assessment of operational preparedness.

The drill tested the military's capacity to manage simultaneous threats and coordinate response across multiple theaters of operation. The surprise nature of the exercise underscored efforts to evaluate real-world readiness without advance preparation or staged conditions.
